detail: no valid layout for all-products after 30s: freeform/all-products: no packing of 19 strips could be wired at any candidate height; every pack the sweep produced left nets unrouted. That is a PACKER defect -- it is producing packs its own router cannot wire -- and it is reported rather than papered over with a looser packing. Treat a spec that cannot be laid out in the requested budget as a layout-model defect until shown otherwise.
